enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Move arm. Turn to left. Breathe. Turn to right. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Lie still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and completing the morning hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast: toast, kettle-boiled tea, and reheating food in the microwave
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Open microwave. Place food container in microwave. Close door. Set timer. Press start. Toast pops up. Remove toast. Pour tea. Remove food from microwave. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink tea. Rinse plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting on the sofa reading news and checking messages on the phone while finishing morning tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open news app. Scroll headlines. Tap article. Scroll article. Open messaging app. Read message. Type reply. Send message. Pick up tea cup. Sip tea. Put down cup. Scroll feed. Lock phone. Put down phone. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the room, switching on the fan, and setting up the computer and desk lamp at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Pick up clothes from floor. Place clothes in hamper. Make bed. Pull up blanket. Fluff pillow. Place pillow at head of bed. Turn on fan. Adjust fan speed. Walk to desk. Plug in computer. Open computer. Turn on computer. Wait for startup. Plug in desk lamp. Turn on desk lamp. Adjust lamp angle. Open drawer. Take out notebook. Place notebook on desk. Sit on chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home: drafting community program plans and budgets on the computer and joining online coordination meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open document. Type draft plan. Scroll. Type more. Open budget spreadsheet. Enter numbers. Calculate totals. Save file. Open calendar. Click meeting link. Join meeting. Turn on camera. Adjust microphone. Speak. Listen. Take notes. Share screen. End meeting. Continue drafting.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch with the induction cooker and microwave, then rinsing the dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Open microwave. Place bowl in microwave. Close door. Set timer. Press start. Stir pan. Turn off cooker. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Rinse dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break: resting on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Put down remote. Lean back. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Close eyes. Rest. Open eyes. Sit up. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home: replying to partner organization emails and preparing volunteer rosters and grant notes on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Open email. Read email. Reply. Send. Open document. Create volunteer roster. Enter names. Assign shifts. Save. Open grant notes. Type notes. Save. Open email. Reply. Send. Edit roster. Save. Close computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Logging off and unwinding with a light stretch and a phone scroll on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Save file. Close computer. Stand up. Stretch arms. Bend forward. Stand up straight. Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media. Scroll. Like post. Scroll. Lock phone. Put down phone. Lean back. Close eyes. Open eyes. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and oven, using the range hood
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Turn on range hood. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Preheat oven. Place tray in oven. Set timer. Stir pan. Turn off cooker. Remove pan. Open oven. Remove tray. Turn off oven.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and cleaning up, loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Serve food. Pick up utensils. Eat dinner. Chew. Swallow. Sip water. Finish meal. Pick up plates. Scrape leftovers into trash. Open dishwasher. Load plates. Load utensils. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start. Wipe table. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Put down remote. Lean back. Pick up phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Stretch. Yawn. Close eyes. Open eyes. Watch TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower with the water heater
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Wait. Undress. Step into shower. Turn on water. Adjust temperature. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Turn off water heater. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time: watching TV, listening to music, and browsing on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Open music app. Play music. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Open social media. Scroll. Like post. Put down phone. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Browse phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: washing up, brushing teeth, and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Pat dry with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom. Change into pajamas. Pull back blanket. Lie on bed.

Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Move arm. Turn to left. Breathe. Turn to right. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Lie still. Breathe. Turn to left. Breathe.
